message:
Running command: cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/lz4/ossfuzz && python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('round_trip_frame_uncompressed_fuzzer.c')
text=p.read_text()
text=text.replace('  size_t uncompressedOffset = rand() % (size + 1);\n\n  FUZZ_ASSERT(uncompressedData || size == 0);\n', '  size_t uncompressedOffset = rand() % (size + 1);\n\n')
p.write_text(text)
PY
cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json <<'JSON'
[
  {"step":1,"file":"lz4/ossfuzz/round_trip_frame_uncompressed_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":104,"var":"data,size","code":"compress_independent_block_mode(data, size);","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes from the fuzz input are passed into the round-trip harness."},
  {"step":2,"file":"lz4/ossfuzz/round_trip_frame_uncompressed_fuzzer.c","function":"compress_independent_block_mode","line":98,"var":"producer","code":"FUZZ_dataProducer_create(data, size);","note":"The input is wrapped in a producer so later helper calls can derive sizes and preferences from the same attacker-controlled buffer."},
  {"step":3,"file":"lz4/ossfuzz/round_trip_frame_uncompressed_fuzzer.c","function":"compress_round_trip","line":31,"var":"size","code":"size = FUZZ_dataProducer_remainingBytes(producer);","note":"The harness uses the remaining attacker-controlled length as the working size for subsequent allocations and offsets."},
  {"step":4,"file":"lz4/ossfuzz/round_trip_frame_uncompressed_fuzzer.c","function":"compress_round_trip","line":33,"var":"uncompressedData","code":"uint8_t *uncompressedData = malloc(size);","note":"A heap buffer is allocated for the synthetic uncompressed segment; when size is zero this may be a zero-length allocation, but the pointer is still used as the source for the next producer."},
  {"step":5,"file":"lz4/ossfuzz/round_trip_frame_uncompressed_fuzzer.c","function":"compress_round_trip","line":36,"var":"uncompressedProducer","code":"FUZZ_dataProducer_create(uncompressedData, size);","note":"The newly allocated buffer is treated as a producer-backed input source for the uncompressed block path."},
  {"step":6,"file":"lz4/ossfuzz/round_trip_frame_uncompressed_fuzzer.c","function":"compress_round_trip","line":37,"var":"uncompressedSize","code":"FUZZ_dataProducer_remainingBytes(uncompressedProducer);","note":"The uncompressed block length is derived from the producer and later fed directly into the frame compressor."},
  {"step":7,"file":"lz4/ossfuzz/round_trip_frame_uncompressed_fuzzer.c","function":"compress_round_trip","line":39,"var":"dstCapacity","code":"LZ4F_compressFrameBound(LZ4_compressBound(size), &prefs) + uncompressedSize;","note":"The output buffer size is computed from attacker-influenced lengths, setting up the compression call sequence."},
  {"step":8,"file":"lz4/ossfuzz/round_trip_frame_uncompressed_fuzzer.c","function":"compress_round_trip","line":49,"var":"headerSize","code":"LZ4F_compressBegin(ctx, dst, dstCapacity, &prefs);","note":"A compression context is initialized for a frame that will mix compressed and uncompressed updates."},
  {"step":9,"file":"lz4/ossfuzz/round_trip_frame_uncompressed_fuzzer.c","function":"compress_round_trip","line":53,"var":"lz4Return","code":"LZ4F_compressUpdate(ctx, dst + compressedSize, dstCapacity, data, uncompressedOffset, NULL);","note":"The first attacker-derived slice is compressed and advances the internal frame state."},
  {"step":10,"file":"lz4/ossfuzz/round_trip_frame_uncompressed_fuzzer.c","function":"compress_round_trip","line":58,"var":"lz4Return","code":"LZ4F_uncompressedUpdate(ctx, dst + compressedSize, dstCapacity, uncompressedData, uncompressedSize, NULL);","note":"The synthetic uncompressed segment is injected into the same frame, exercising the vulnerable mixed-mode path."},
  {"step":11,"file":"lz4/lib/lz4frame.c","function":"LZ4F_uncompressedUpdate","line":1030,"var":"cctxPtr","code":"return LZ4F_compressUpdateImpl(cctxPtr, dstBuffer, dstCapacity, srcBuffer, srcSize, compressOptionsPtr, LZ4B_UNCOMPRESSED);","note":"The uncompressed update dispatches into the shared implementation with blockCompression set to uncompressed."},
  {"step":12,"file":"lz4/lib/lz4frame.c","function":"LZ4F_compressUpdateImpl","line":869,"var":"cctxPtr->blockCompression","code":"if (cctxPtr->blockCompression != blockCompression) { bytesWritten = LZ4F_flush(...); cctxPtr->blockCompression = blockCompression; }","note":"Switching from compressed to uncompressed mode forces a flush and changes the frame state before the next block is processed."},
  {"step":13,"file":"lz4/lib/lz4frame.c","function":"LZ4F_compressUpdateImpl","line":923,"var":"cctxPtr->tmpIn","code":"memcpy(cctxPtr->tmpIn, srcPtr, sizeToCopy);","note":"Remaining bytes are copied into the internal temporary buffer, which later feeds the compression routines that read uninitialized state in the buggy path."},
  {"step":14,"file":"lz4/lib/lz4frame.c","function":"LZ4F_compressUpdateImpl","line":934,"var":"cctxPtr->xxh","code":"(void)XXH32_update(&(cctxPtr->xxh), srcBuffer, srcSize);","note":"The frame checksum is updated over the attacker-controlled source range, completing the propagation into the compression context."},
  {"step":15,"file":"lz4/ossfuzz/round_trip_frame_uncompressed_fuzzer.c","function":"compress_round_trip","line":64,"var":"lz4Return","code":"LZ4F_compressUpdate(ctx, dst + compressedSize, dstCapacity, data + uncompressedOffset, size - uncompressedOffset, NULL);","note":"Compression resumes after the uncompressed block, reusing the same context and triggering the buggy fast-reset compression state."},
  {"step":16,"file":"lz4/lib/lz4frame.c","function":"LZ4F_compressUpdateImpl","line":897,"var":"compress","code":"compressFunc_t const compress = LZ4F_selectCompression(...);","note":"The selected compression function eventually reaches LZ4_compress_fast_extState_fastReset through LZ4F_makeBlock, where the MSAN report shows use of uninitialized state."}
]
